sessions.title: Introduction to GitHub Copilot
sessions.description: Learn what Copilot does, how the LLM works, and what plan tiers and privacy rules apply. Then set it up in the IDE.

sessions.title: Copilot Chat & Inline Suggestions
sessions.description: Use the chat interface, slash commands, inline completions, and Next Edit Suggestions in the IDE.

sessions.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
sessions.description: Build a todo API with focused prompts. Check what CLI /refine changed and compare context before accepting the result.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot CLI & App
sessions.description: Critique a repair plan and check CLI controls and fleet results. Practise queueing, recovery, and terminal automation.

sessions.title: Agent Mode in the IDE
sessions.description: Give Copilot a multi-step task in VS Code. Follow how it reads files, runs commands, and responds to errors.

sessions.title: Copilot Spaces & Context Management
sessions.description: Choose context for the Storefront project and inspect the CLI's loaded instructions. Correct a stale rule and compare the results.

sessions.title: Copilot for Code Review & PRs
sessions.description: Review a change yourself, then compare local /review and /security-review with Copilot PR review. Check the findings and test focused fixes.

sessions.title: GitHub Copilot App for Developers
sessions.description: Check the app workspace and compare rubber-duck and spar critiques. Return a forked plan note, then review the repair and decide if it is ready for a PR.

sessions.title: Repair and Refactor a Broken Python Application
sessions.description: Fix the Python application in failure order and check LSP references against inline rules. Refactor from an accepted plan while keeping reports unchanged.

sessions.title: Migrate a Legacy Java Service to Modern .NET
sessions.description: Establish how the legacy Java service behaves before porting it to modern .NET. Use focused tests to check compatibility.

sessions.title: Copilot App, Plugins & Canvas Extensions
sessions.description: Build a shared canvas through Copilot App customization. Define its state limits and actions, then record your review.

sessions.title: Copilot Cloud Agent
sessions.description: Assign issues to Copilot's cloud agent. It creates a branch, writes code, runs tests, and opens a PR.

sessions.title: MCP Servers & Custom Tool Integration
sessions.description: Use Model Context Protocol servers to give Copilot access to external tools, APIs, and data sources.

sessions.title: Custom Agents & Agent Profiles
sessions.description: Check a JavaScript LSP lookup and tighten a custom-agent profile. Run the agent and check that it stops before an out-of-scope source change.

sessions.title: Agent Skills & the Copilot Ecosystem
sessions.description: Run repository skills and compare interviews from pinned skill versions before planning. Review Chronicle suggestions for the selected sessions without applying them automatically.

sessions.title: GitHub Actions & Workflow Generation
sessions.description: Generate CI and design deployment for one Node.js application. Repair its workflows, validate a custom action, and save the local check results.

sessions.title: Infrastructure as Code with Copilot
sessions.description: Use Copilot to write, connect, validate, and security-review Terraform modules. Compare Bicep in the trainer demo or optional exercise.

sessions.title: CI/CD Pipeline Debugging & Agentic Remediation
sessions.description: Use logs and local checks to diagnose pipeline failures. Reproduce a staged failure and review the proposed security fix.

sessions.title: Brady's Squad: Human-Led AI Teams
sessions.description: Assign scoped work to persistent roles with Brady's Squad. Save the team's decisions and results so a person can review them.

sessions.title: Spec Kit: Specification-Driven Development
sessions.description: Turn Spec Kit tasks into issues and implement them in stages. Run convergence checks and update the specification when requirements change.

sessions.title: HVE Core: Evidence-Led Delivery with RPI
sessions.description: Develop one API feature through HVE Research, Plan, Implement, Review, and Follow-up. A person reviews the results and makes the delivery decision.

sessions.title: Build Reliable Agent Applications with the GitHub Copilot SDK
sessions.description: Build and test a TypeScript agent with streaming and a deterministic custom tool. Handle permissions, block disallowed calls with hooks, and inspect OpenTelemetry traces.

sessions.title: End-to-End Capstone Project
sessions.description: Complete one agentic implementation task from a governed specification. Review the result and make the handover decision.

sessions.title: Work Effectively in the GitHub Copilot App
sessions.description: Compare answers with and without repository context. Revise a working brief when source material changes, then check it in a fresh session.

sessions.title: Interview Ideas and Shape Better Work
sessions.description: Install and use a project interview skill to turn an unclear request into a decision brief. Revisit affected decisions when constraints change, then check the brief.

sessions.title: Plan Work with GitHub Issues and MCP
sessions.description: Inspect existing work through GitHub MCP before proposing an issue hierarchy. Preview the write, create the issues, and read them back to check and correct the result.

sessions.title: Build and Use a Planning Canvas
sessions.description: Create a planning canvas and simplify it. Detect when its state differs from GitHub, then update it to match.

sessions.title: Orchestrate Agents and Workstreams
sessions.description: Supervise child sessions that review GitHub issues or local developer inputs. Redirect the work when needed, then check and reconcile the findings.

sessions.title: Automate Delivery Follow-up and Connect Work Systems
sessions.description: Run a manual, draft-only Automation twice, changing an approved input between runs. Compare the results and decide which work system remains authoritative.
